name: Town hall (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Three-storey municipal offices and town hall, 30 x 18 m: limestone ground floor and brick upper floors with stone bands, pilasters and tall windows, a raised entrance under a two-storey portico of six columns with an entablature and a pediment (blank roundel), broad steps. Inside: a lobby with a reception counter, registry, information and back offices, toilets on each floor, offices and a meeting room above, the mayor's office and a council chamber with a dais and a fixed horseshoe desk on the top floor; a stair core with a roof door, a lift, roof plant and a flagpole.
